title: Animal Names That Mean Courage: 150+ Brave & Bold Ideas 🦁
description: Give your pet a name that embodies bravery. Discover names from mythology, history, and world languages that literally mean courage, bravery, and valor.

content.text: Courage is one of the most admired qualities in any being — human or animal. Naming your pet after courage gives them an identity of bravery from day one. Whether for a rescue pet who overcame hardship or a naturally bold companion, these names carry deep meaning.
Andreas (manly, brave), Valentina (strong, courageous), Thaddeus (courageous heart), Ari (lion, brave). Leon or Leo means lion — the universal symbol of courage.
Shura (Arabic for bravery), Yong (Chinese for brave), Isamu (Japanese for courage), Bali (Sanskrit for strength), Koa (Hawaiian for brave).
Animals associated with bravery: Lion, Eagle, Hawk, Bear, Wolf, Tiger, Falcon. Simply naming your pet after these animals conveys courage.

faq.q: Why name a pet after courage?
faq.a: Especially meaningful for rescue animals, pets who've overcome illness, or naturally protective companions. It honors their spirit.

faq.q: What's the most popular courage pet name?
faq.a: Leo (lion) is by far the most popular courage-inspired pet name, followed by Brave, Hero, and Valor.
